title: 第四千二百二十一章 三圣为奴第四千二百二十章 成功套住
content_zh:
带着玄妙气息的大道纹理从御雷环内浮现而出，就如同突然间有了生命似得，如一条条细小的灵虫在御雷环上游走。
这一刻，原本朴实无华的御雷环，一下子变得无比闪耀，那爆发出的绚丽光彩，竟是将八雷尊者身上绽放出的紫色雷霆都给遮盖了下去。
蕴藏着生命气息的绿色光彩，刹那间洒满了太初神殿的整个第一层空间。
浓烈到极致的生命气息，改变了第一层空间的环境，使得太初神殿第一层空间的大地上，乃至更远处的四周的墙壁上，有成片成片的绿色植物在疯狂生长，它们不借助土壤，不需要养分，就这么贴在坚硬的地面上疯狂的生长着。
刹那间，太初神殿整个第一层空间内，就变成了一片绿色海洋，被绿色植被覆盖。
察觉到套在脖子上的御雷环，八雷尊者的心陡然一沉，尽管他还不是十分清楚御雷环的作用，但早已从剑尘的动机中猜出了个大概，这让他整个人瞬间变得无比狂暴，他反手就是一掌，充满毁灭气息的雷霆力量将剑尘打的吐血倒飞出去，体内的五脏六腑再一次被震碎，浑身骨骼都断裂大半。
一击将剑尘打飞出去后，八雷尊者就立马单手抓住脖子上的御雷环，想要往外扯。
然而御雷环上浮现出的大道符文已经蔓延出来，就如同一颗大树的根须似得，视八雷尊者如土壤，无数的根须已经深深的扎入了八雷尊者的脖颈中，任八雷尊者使出再大的力气，都无法将御雷环从自己脖子上摘下。
八雷尊者发出怒吼，仙尊境五重天的气势轰然爆发，滔天威压弥漫整个第一层空间，他双手合力，用出最大力气去摘取御雷环。
然而，御雷环依旧稳固如山，牢牢的吸附在八雷尊者的脖颈上，仿佛融为一体。
“该死，这是什么东西，快离开老夫的身体！”八雷尊者大声咆哮，当下心中发狠，一手成刀，带着一抹疯狂与决绝猛然挥向自己的脖子，当场将自己的脑袋斩了下来。
顿时，八雷尊者的头颅与身躯分离！
然而，这一招依旧无效，御雷环上那由繁奥纹理所化的根茎，并不是单纯的刺入八雷尊者的脖子中，　而是扎入了八雷尊者的生命本源中，连同他的元神都被一同捆绑。
换言之，除非他形神俱灭，彻底陨落，否则，都无法以自身实力摆脱御雷环的束缚。
因为他的力量，还远不到能够与御雷环抗衡的地步。
“剑尘，你这个小王八蛋，老夫与你无冤无仇，你为什么要来害老夫？”八雷尊者发出歇斯底里的怒吼，他开始不计后果的提升实力，身上气势节节攀升，很快就突破了仙尊五重天的极致，重新跨入了六重天的领域。
然而饶是如此，他也依旧无法将御雷环从自己身上摘除。
并且，更让八雷尊者感到绝望的是，他感受到了一股莫名的禁锢之力在影响自己的元神，想要干扰自己的思维意志。
他本就心高气傲，有宁死不屈的傲骨，岂能任由自己被这股禁锢之力干扰，立即开始穷尽一切力量开始反抗。
不过在他的全力反抗之下，御雷环对他的干扰与控制，速度一下子变得缓慢了一些。

不远处，一颗刚刚才生长出来的大树树冠上，剑尘驻足停留在上面，脸色呈现病态般的苍白，五道玄剑气，抽空了他将近八层的元神之力，此刻他元神之力几乎陷入干枯。
但他此刻却浑然不顾自己元神之力的损耗，一双目光死死的盯着八雷尊者。
鏖战了这么久，他好不容易才将御雷环套在八雷尊者脖子上，御雷环能否成功控制八雷尊者，眼下无疑是最关键的时刻。
“放心，八雷尊者最巅峰的时期也不过才仙尊境六重天，他绝不可能逃过御雷环的禁锢，剩下的一切交给御雷环即可，等着看便是。”
似乎察觉到剑尘的担忧，生命之源在剑尘的识海空间中出言安危，胸有成竹。
“剑尘，你这个小兔崽子，老夫要杀了你！”
content_en:
The texture of the avenue with a mysterious aura emerged from the Thunder Ring, as if it suddenly had life, like tiny spiritual insects swimming on the Thunder Ring.
At this moment, the originally plain and simple Thunder Control Ring suddenly became extremely sparkling. The burst of brilliant brilliance actually covered up the purple thunder that bloomed from the Eight Thunder Masters.
The green brilliance containing the breath of life instantly filled the entire first floor space of Taichu Temple.
The extremely strong breath of life has changed the environment of the first level of space, causing patches of green plants to grow crazily on the ground of the first level of Taichu Temple, and even on the surrounding walls further away. They do not rely on soil or nutrients, and they just stick to the hard ground and grow crazily.
In an instant, the entire first floor of Taichu Temple turned into a sea of ​​green, covered by green vegetation.
Sensing the Thunder Control Ring around his neck, Lord Eight Thunder's heart suddenly sank. Although he was not very clear about the function of the Thunder Control Ring, he had already guessed a rough idea from Jian Chen's motives. This made his whole body instantly become extremely violent. With a palm of his backhand, the thunderous power full of destructive aura knocked Jian Chen out and vomited blood. The internal organs in his body were once again shattered, and most of his bones were broken.
After sending Jian Chen flying with one blow, Lord Eight Thunders immediately grabbed the thunder ring around his neck with one hand and tried to pull it out.
However, the Dao Rune that appeared on the Thunder Ring has spread out, like the roots of a big tree. Treating Lord Ba Lei as soil, countless roots have penetrated deeply into Lord Eight Thunder's neck. No matter how hard he exerts his strength, he can't take off the Ring of Thunder from his neck.
Lord Eight Thunder roared, and the momentum of the fifth level of the Immortal Realm exploded. The overwhelming pressure filled the entire first level space. He worked together with both hands and used his maximum strength to pick up the Thunder Ring.
However, the Royal Thunder Ring is still as stable as a mountain, firmly attached to the Eight Thunder Master's neck, as if integrated into one body.
"Damn it, what is this thing? Get out of my body!" Lord Ba Lei roared loudly. He was furious in his heart. He turned a knife into a hand and swung it towards his neck with a touch of madness and determination, and cut off his head on the spot.
Suddenly, Lord Ba Lei’s head and body separated!
However, this move was still ineffective. The rhizomes formed from complex textures on the Thunder Ring did not simply pierce into the neck of the Eight Thunder Lords, but penetrated into the life source of the Eight Thunder Lords, and his soul was bound together.
In other words, unless he is completely destroyed physically and mentally, he will not be able to escape the shackles of the Thunder Ring with his own strength.
Because his strength is far from being able to compete with the Thunder Ring.
"Jian Chen, you little bastard, I have no grievances against you, why do you want to harm me?" Lord Eight Thunder roared hysterically. He began to increase his strength regardless of the consequences, and his aura was rising steadily. He soon broke through the limit of the fifth heaven of the Immortal Lord and entered the realm of the sixth heaven again.
However, despite this, he still could not remove the Thunder Ring from himself.
Moreover, what made Master Ba Lei feel even more desperate was that he felt an inexplicable power of imprisonment affecting his soul, trying to interfere with his thinking and will.
He was already arrogant and proud, and he would rather die than surrender. How could he allow himself to be disturbed by this restraining force? He immediately began to use up all his strength to resist.
However, under his full resistance, the speed of Yu Leihuan's interference and control on him suddenly became slower.
Not far away, on the crown of a big tree that had just grown, Jian Chen stopped and stayed on it. His face was as pale as a disease. The five mysterious sword energy drained away nearly eight levels of his soul power. At this moment, his soul power was almost trapped.Dry.
But at this moment, he didn't care about the loss of his soul power, and stared at Lord Ba Lei with a pair of eyes.
After fighting for so long, he finally managed to put the Royal Thunder Ring around the Eight Thunder Lord's neck. Whether the Royal Thunder Ring can successfully control the Eight Thunder Lords is undoubtedly the most critical moment now.
"Don't worry, Lord Ba Lei was only at the sixth level of the Immortal Realm at his peak. There is no way he can escape the imprisonment of the Thunder Ring. We can leave the rest to the Thunder Ring. Just wait and see."
As if aware of Jian Chen's worries, the source of life spoke out in Jian Chen's sea of consciousness space, confidently.
"Jian Chen, you little bastard, I'm going to kill you!"
